label: SpO₂
why: Low oxygen saturation can mean hypoxia from a cabin atmosphere fault, fire or smoke.
howDecided: Rule SPO-01: SpO₂ < 94 % → caution. Earth clinical convention, not a NASA in-flight limit (health-indicators §4).
next: Re-measure: warm your hands, sit still for 1 minute, finger fully in, hand at heart level. Still below 94 % → tell the CMO now.

label: SpO₂
why: Low oxygen saturation can mean hypoxia from a cabin atmosphere fault, fire or smoke.
howDecided: Rule SPO-02: SpO₂ < 90 % → warning. Earth clinical convention, not a NASA in-flight limit (health-indicators §4).
